name: Yokum's Vacationland Lower Campground
note: The larger of Yokum's Vacationland's two Seneca Rocks campgrounds, about 1 km north of the Rocks behind Yokum's restaurant along the North Fork of the South Branch Potomac, with a view of Seneca Rocks; RV hookup sites in a row along the river and around an open field, tent and electric pop-up sites, bathhouse. No reservations for camping (first come, first served); closes for winter. RV camping $50 for 1-4 people, electric tent/pop-up $40, tents $12/person. Sister campground Princess Snowbird (id 14255) stays open all winter. Unrated on RV Life; Yokum's Vacationland Google 4.6 over 569 reviews. --Claude
